notes: Standardize-then-regress modeling sequence relating cumulative diastolic BP exposure (AUC0726_dia, AUC2645_dia) to BrainAGE45: PROC STANDARD (mean 0 SD 1), three nested PROC REG models with standardized betas + CIs (stb clb) and ODS ParameterEstimates, and PROC CORR of exposures with the outcome. Row-subsetting to complete cases moved into a preceding DATA step; models are the author's own. Run against a mock BP_area (10 participants) matching the columns the sequence reads; real BP_area derives from restricted Dunedin data.
